spell:71.name: Defensive Stance
spell:71.description: A defensive combat stance. Decreases damage taken by -10% and damage caused by -5%. Increases threat generated.

spell:72.name: Shield Bash
spell:72.description: Bash the target with your shield dazing them and interrupting spellcasting, which prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 6 sec.

spell:75.name: Auto Shot
spell:75.description: Automatically shoots the target until cancelled. Ranged attacks fired by a Hunter all have 15% increased attack speed.

spell:81.name: Dodge
spell:81.description: Gives a chance to dodge enemy melee attacks.

spell:99.name: Demoralizing Roar
spell:99.description: The druid roars, decreasing nearby enemies' melee attack power by -31. Lasts 30 sec.

spell:100.name: Charge
spell:100.description: Charge an enemy, generate 9 rage, and stun it for 1.5 sec. Cannot be used in combat.

spell:107.name: Block
spell:107.description: Gives a chance to block enemy melee and ranged attacks.

spell:118.name: Polymorph
spell:118.description: Transforms the enemy into a sheep, forcing it to wander around for up to 20 sec. While wandering, the sheep cannot attack or cast spells but will regenerate very quickly. Any damage will transform the target back into its normal form. Only one target can be polymorphed at a time. Only works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters.
spell:118.auraDescription: Cannot attack or cast spells. Increased regeneration.

spell:122.name: Frost Nova
spell:122.description: Blasts enemies near the caster for 19 to 21 Frost damage and freezes them in place for up to 8 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

spell:130.name: Slow Fall
spell:130.description: Slows friendly party or raid target's falling speed for 30 sec.

spell:136.name: Mend Pet
spell:136.description: Heals your pet for 125 health over 15 sec.

spell:285.name: Heroic Strike
spell:285.description: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 32 and causes a high amount of threat.

spell:325.name: Lightning Shield
spell:325.description: The caster is surrounded by 3 balls of lightning. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, the attacker will be struck for 29 Nature damage. This expends one lightning ball. Only one ball will fire every few seconds. Lasts 10 min. Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time.
spell:325.auraDescription: Causes 29 Nature damage to attacker on hit. 3 charges.

spell:355.name: Taunt
spell:355.description: Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.

spell:370.name: Purge
spell:370.description: Purges the enemy target, removing 1 beneficial magic effect.

spell:475.name: Remove Curse
spell:475.description: Removes 1 Curse from a friendly target.

spell:498.name: Divine Protection
spell:498.description: Reduces all damage taken by -50% for 12 sec. Once protected, the target cannot be targeted by Divine Shield, Divine Protection, or Hand of Protection again for 2 min. Cannot be used within 30 sec of using Avenging Wrath.

spell:526.name: Cure Toxins
spell:526.description: Cures 1 poison effect and 1 disease effect on a friendly target.

spell:527.name: Dispel Magic
spell:527.description: Dispels magic on the target, removing 1 harmful spell from a friend or 1 beneficial spell from an enemy.

spell:528.name: Cure Disease
spell:528.description: Removes 1 disease from the friendly target.

spell:548.name: Lightning Bolt
spell:548.description: Casts a bolt of lightning at the target for 45 Nature damage.

spell:586.name: Fade
spell:586.description: Fade out, temporarily reducing all your threat for 10 sec.

spell:588.name: Inner Fire
spell:588.description: A burst of Holy energy fills the caster, increasing armor by 315. Each melee or ranged damage hit against the priest will remove one charge. Lasts 30 min or until 20 charges are used.

spell:598.name: Smite
spell:598.description: Smite an enemy for 54 Holy damage.

spell:600.name: Power Word: Shield
spell:600.description: Draws on the soul of the friendly target to shield them, absorbing 158 damage. Lasts 30 sec. While the shield holds, spellcasting will not be interrupted by damage. Once shielded, the target cannot be shielded again for 15 sec.

spell:604.name: Dampen Magic
spell:604.description: Dampens magic used against the targeted party member, decreasing damage taken from spells by up to -10 and healing spells by up to -11. Lasts 10 min.
spell:604.auraDescription: Reduces magic damage taken by up to -10 and healing by up to -11.

spell:633.name: Lay on Hands
spell:633.description: Heals a friendly target for an amount equal to the Paladin's maximum health. If used on self, the Paladin cannot be targeted by Divine Shield, Divine Protection, Hand of Protection, or self-targeted Lay on Hands again for 2 min. Also cannot be used on self within 30 sec of using Avenging Wrath.

spell:674.name: Dual Wield
spell:674.description: Allows one-hand and off-hand weapons to be equipped in the off-hand.

spell:676.name: Disarm
spell:676.description: Disarm the enemy's main hand and ranged weapons for 10 sec.

spell:688.name: Summon Imp
spell:688.description: Summons an Imp under the command of the Warlock.

spell:689.name: Drain Life
spell:689.description: Transfers 10 health every 1 sec from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec.
spell:689.auraDescription: Drains 10 health every 1 sec to the caster.

spell:693.name: Create Soulstone
spell:693.description:
Creates a Minor Soulstone. The Soulstone can be used to store one target's soul. If the target dies while his soul is stored, he will be able to resurrect with -400 health and 700 mana.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

spell:694.name: Mocking Blow
spell:694.description: A mocking attack that causes a moderate amount of threat and forces the target to focus attacks on you for 6 sec. If the target is tauntable, also deals weapon damage.

spell:696.name: Demon Skin
spell:696.description: Protects the caster, increasing armor by 265, and increasing the amount of health generated through spells and effects by 20%. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Warlock at any time. Lasts 30 min.
spell:696.auraDescription: Increases armor by 265, and amount of health generated through spells and effects by 20%

spell:697.name: Summon Voidwalker
spell:697.description: Summons a Voidwalker under the command of the Warlock.

spell:703.name: Garrote
spell:703.description: Garrote the enemy, causing 204 damage over 18 sec, increased by your attack power. Must be stealthed and behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.

spell:705.name: Shadow Bolt
spell:705.description: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy, causing 48 Shadow damage.

spell:707.name: Immolate
spell:707.description: Burns the enemy for 19 Fire damage and then an additional 40 Fire damage over 15 sec.

spell:755.name: Health Funnel
spell:755.description: Gives 12 health to the caster's pet every second for 10 sec as long as the caster channels.

spell:770.name: Faerie Fire
spell:770.description: Decrease the armor of the target by -5% for 5 min. While affected, the target cannot stealth or turn invisible.
spell:770.auraDescription: Decreases armor by -5%. Cannot stealth or turn invisible.

spell:779.name: Swipe (Bear)
spell:779.description: Swipe nearby enemies, inflicting 9 damage. Damage increased by attack power.

spell:782.name: Thorns
spell:782.description: Thorns sprout from the friendly target causing 6 Nature damage to attackers when hit. Lasts 10 min.

spell:783.name: Travel Form
spell:783.description:
Shapeshift into travel form, increasing movement speed by 40%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects. Only useable outdoors.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.
spell:783.auraDescription: Immune to Polymorph effects. Movement speed increased by 40%.

spell:822.name: Magic Resistance
spell:822.description: Reduces the chance you will be hit by spells by -2%.

spell:837.name: Frostbolt
spell:837.description: Launches a bolt of frost at the enemy, causing 51 to 57 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by -40% for 6 sec.

spell:853.name: Hammer of Justice
spell:853.description: Stuns the target for 3 sec and interrupts non-player spellcasting for 3 sec.

spell:970.name: Shadow Word: Pain
spell:970.description: A word of darkness that causes 120 Shadow damage over 18 sec.

spell:982.name: Revive Pet
spell:982.description: Revive your pet, returning it to life with 15% of its base health.

spell:990.name: Conjure Food
spell:990.description:
Conjures 2 loaves of rye, providing the mage and his allies with something to eat.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

spell:1002.name: Eyes of the Beast
spell:1002.description: Take direct control of your pet and see through its eyes for 1 min.

spell:1008.name: Amplify Magic
spell:1008.description: Amplifies magic used against the targeted party member, increasing damage taken from spells by up to 15 and healing spells by up to 16. Lasts 10 min.
spell:1008.auraDescription: Increases magic damage taken by up to 15 and healing by up to 16.

spell:1014.name: Curse of Agony
spell:1014.description: Curses the target with agony, causing 180 Shadow damage over 24 sec. This damage is dealt slowly at first, and builds up as the Curse reaches its full duration. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

spell:1022.name: Hand of Protection
spell:1022.description: A targeted party or raid member is protected from all physical attacks for 6 sec, but during that time they cannot attack or use physical abilities. Players may only have one Hand on them per Paladin at any one time. Once protected, the target cannot be targeted by Divine Shield, Divine Protection, or Hand of Protection again for 2 min. Cannot be targeted on players who have used Avenging Wrath within the last 30 sec.
spell:1022.auraDescription: Immune to physical attacks. Cannot attack or use physical abilities.

spell:1044.name: Hand of Freedom
spell:1044.description: Places a Hand on the friendly target, granting immunity to movement impairing effects for 6 sec. Players may only have one Hand on them per Paladin at any one time.

spell:1062.name: Entangling Roots
spell:1062.description: Roots the target in place and causes 50 Nature damage over 15 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.
spell:1062.auraDescription: Rooted. Causes 10 Nature damage every 3 seconds.

spell:1066.name: Aquatic Form
spell:1066.description:
Shapeshift into aquatic form, increasing swim speed by 50% and allowing the druid to breathe underwater. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.
spell:1066.auraDescription: Immune to Polymorph effects. Increases swim speed by 50% and allows underwater breathing.

spell:1108.name: Curse of Weakness
spell:1108.description: Target's melee attack power is reduced by -41 and armor is reduced by -5% for 2 min. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.
spell:1108.auraDescription: Melee attack power reduced by -41, and armor is reduced by -5%.

spell:1120.name: Drain Soul
spell:1120.description: Drains the soul of the target, causing 55 Shadow damage over 15 sec. If the target is at or below 25% health, Drain Soul causes four times the normal damage. If the target dies while being drained, and yields experience or honor, the caster gains a Soul Shard. Each time the Drain Soul damages the target, it also has a chance to generate a Soul Shard. Soul Shards are required for other spells.

spell:1130.name: Hunter's Mark
spell:1130.description: Places the Hunter's Mark on the target, increasing the ranged attack power of all attackers against that target by 20. In addition, the target of this ability can always be seen by the hunter whether it stealths or turns invisible. The target also appears on the mini-map. Lasts for 5 min.
spell:1130.auraDescription: All attackers gain 20 ranged attack power against this target.

spell:1152.name: Purify
spell:1152.description: Purifies the friendly target, removing 1 disease effect and 1 poison effect.

spell:1160.name: Demoralizing Shout
spell:1160.description: Reduces the melee attack power of all enemies within 10 yards by -35 for 30 sec.

spell:1244.name: Power Word: Fortitude
spell:1244.description: Power infuses the target, increasing their Stamina by 8 for 30 min.

spell:1430.name: Rejuvenation
spell:1430.description: Heals the target for 145 over 15 sec.

spell:1449.name: Arcane Explosion
spell:1449.description: Causes an explosion of arcane magic around the caster, causing 32 Arcane damage to all targets within 10 yards.

spell:1455.name: Life Tap
spell:1455.description: Converts 216 health into 116 mana. Spell power increases the amount of mana returned.

spell:1460.name: Arcane Intellect
spell:1460.description: Increases the target's Intellect by 7 for 30 min.

spell:1494.name: Track Beasts
spell:1494.description: Shows the location of all nearby beasts on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

spell:1513.name: Scare Beast
spell:1513.description: Scares a beast, causing it to run in fear for up to 10 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only one beast can be feared at a time.

spell:1515.name: Tame Beast
spell:1515.description: Begins taming a beast to be your companion. Your armor is reduced by -100% while you focus on taming the beast for 20 sec. If you lose the beast's attention for any reason, the taming process will fail. Once tamed, the beast will be very unhappy and disloyal. Try feeding the pet immediately to make it happy.

spell:1535.name: Fire Nova
spell:1535.description: Causes the shaman's active Fire totem to emit a wave of flames, inflicting 48 Fire damage to enemies within 10 yards of the totem.

spell:1715.name: Hamstring
spell:1715.description: Maims the enemy, reducing movement speed by -50% for 15 sec.

spell:1758.name: Sinister Strike
spell:1758.description: An instant strike that causes 10 damage in addition to 100% of your normal weapon damage. Awards 1 combo point.

spell:1766.name: Kick
spell:1766.description: A quick kick that interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.

spell:1776.name: Gouge
spell:1776.description: Causes 43 damage, incapacitating the opponent for 4 sec, and turns off your attack. Target must be facing you. Any damage caused will revive the target. Awards 1 combo point.

spell:1784.name: Stealth
spell:1784.description: Allows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by -30%. Lasts until cancelled.

spell:1804.name: Pick Lock
spell:1804.description: Allows opening of locked chests and doors.

spell:1966.name: Feint
spell:1966.description: Performs a feint, causing no damage but lowering your threat by a small amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.

spell:2006.name: Resurrection
spell:2006.description: Brings a dead player back to life with 70 health and 135 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

spell:2008.name: Ancestral Spirit
spell:2008.description: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 65 health and 120 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

spell:2120.name: Flamestrike
spell:2120.description: Calls down a pillar of fire, burning all enemies within the area for 52 Fire damage and an additional 48 Fire damage over 8 sec.

spell:2137.name: Fire Blast
spell:2137.description: Blasts the enemy for 57 Fire damage.

spell:2457.name: Battle Stance
spell:2457.description: A balanced combat stance that increases the armor penetration of all of your attacks by 10%.

spell:2479.name: Honorless Target
spell:2479.auraDescription: You are currently worth no honor points to the enemy.

spell:2481.name: Find Treasure
spell:2481.description: Allows the dwarf to sense nearby treasure, making it appear on the minimap. Lasts until cancelled.

spell:2484.name: Earthbind Totem
spell:2484.description: Summons an Earthbind Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 45 sec that slows the movement speed of enemies within 10 yards.

spell:2565.name: Shield Block
spell:2565.description: Increases your chance to block and block value by 100% for 10 sec.
spell:2565.auraDescription: Block chance and block value increased by 100%.

spell:2589.name: Backstab
spell:2589.description: Backstab the target, causing 150% weapon damage plus 30 to the target. Must be behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point.

spell:2637.name: Hibernate
spell:2637.description: Forces the enemy target to sleep for up to 20 sec. Any damage will awaken the target. Only one target can be forced to hibernate at a time. Only works on Beasts and Dragonkin.

spell:2641.name: Dismiss Pet
spell:2641.description: Dismiss your pet. Dismissing your pet will reduce its happiness by 50.

spell:2645.name: Ghost Wolf
spell:2645.description: Turns the Shaman into a Ghost Wolf, increasing speed by 40%. As a Ghost Wolf, the Shaman is less hindered by effects that would reduce movement speed. Only useable outdoors.
spell:2645.auraDescription:
Increases movement speed by 40%.
Effects that reduce movement speed may not bring you below your normal movement speed.

spell:2687.name: Bloodrage
spell:2687.description: Generates 20 rage at the cost of health, and then generates an additional 10 rage over 10 sec.

spell:2974.name: Wing Clip
spell:2974.description: Maims the enemy, reducing the target's movement speed by -50% for 10 sec.

spell:2983.name: Sprint
spell:2983.description: Increases the rogue's movement speed by 50% for 15 sec. Does not break stealth.

spell:3127.name: Parry
spell:3127.description: Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks.

spell:3140.name: Fireball
spell:3140.description: Hurls a fiery ball that causes 84 Fire damage and an additional 12 Fire damage over 8 sec.

spell:3599.name: Searing Totem
spell:3599.description: Summons a Searing Totem with 5 health at your feet for 30 sec that repeatedly attacks an enemy within 20 yards for 9 Fire damage.

spell:3975.name: Standard Scope
spell:3975.description: Attaches a permanent scope to a bow or gun that increases its damage by 2.

spell:5116.name: Concussive Shot
spell:5116.description: Dazes the target, slowing movement speed by -50% for 4 sec.

spell:5118.name: Aspect of the Cheetah
spell:5118.description: The hunter takes on the aspects of a cheetah, increasing movement speed by 30%. If the hunter is struck, he will be dazed for 4 sec. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
spell:5118.auraDescription: 30% increased movement speed. Dazed if struck.

spell:5144.name: Arcane Missiles
spell:5144.description: Launches Arcane Missiles at the enemy, causing 36 Arcane damage every 1 sec for 4 sec.

spell:5171.name: Slice and Dice
spell:5171.description:
Finishing move that increases melee attack speed by 20%. Lasts longer per combo point:
   1 point  : 10.1 seconds
   2 points: 13.13 seconds
   3 points: 16.16 seconds
   4 points: 19.19 seconds
   5 points: 22.22 seconds

spell:5178.name: Wrath
spell:5178.description: Causes 49 Nature damage to the target.

spell:5187.name: Healing Touch
spell:5187.description: Heals a friendly target for 195 to 243.

spell:5211.name: Bash
spell:5211.description: Stuns the target for 2 sec and interrupts non-player spellcasting for 3 sec.

spell:5227.name: Underwater Breathing
spell:5227.description: Underwater breath lasts 233% longer than normal.

spell:5229.name: Enrage
spell:5229.description: Generates 20 rage, and then generates an additional 10 rage over 10 sec, but reduces base armor by 27% in Bear Form and 16% in Dire Bear Form.
spell:5229.auraDescription: Gain 1 rage per second. Base armor reduced.

spell:5232.name: Mark of the Wild
spell:5232.description: Increases the friendly target's armor by 65 and all attributes by 2 for 30 min.
spell:5232.auraDescription: Increases armor by 65 and all attributes by 2.

spell:5242.name: Battle Shout
spell:5242.description: The warrior shouts, increasing attack power of all raid and party members within 30 yards by 35. Lasts 2 min.

spell:5277.name: Evasion
spell:5277.description: The rogue's dodge chance will increase by 50% for 15 sec.

spell:5487.name: Bear Form
spell:5487.description:
Shapeshift into bear form, increasing melee attack power by 30, armor contribution from cloth and leather items by 180%, and Stamina by 25%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.
spell:5487.auraDescription: Immune to Polymorph effects. Increases melee attack power by 30, armor contribution from cloth and leather items by 180%, and Stamina by 25%.

spell:5506.name: Conjure Water
spell:5506.description:
Conjures 2 bottles of purified water, providing the mage and his allies with something to drink.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

spell:5676.name: Searing Pain
spell:5676.description: Inflict searing pain on the enemy target, causing 34 Fire damage. Causes a high amount of threat.

spell:5697.name: Unending Breath
spell:5697.description: Allows the target to breathe underwater for 10 min.

spell:5782.name: Fear
spell:5782.description: Strikes fear in the enemy, causing it to run in fear for up to 10 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only 1 target can be feared at a time.

spell:6074.name: Renew
spell:6074.description: Heals the target for 100 over 15 sec.

spell:6197.name: Eagle Eye
spell:6197.description: Zooms in the hunter's vision. Only usable outdoors. Lasts 1 min.

spell:6201.name: Create Healthstone
spell:6201.description:
Creates a Minor Healthstone that can be used to instantly restore 100 health.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

spell:6222.name: Corruption
spell:6222.description: Corrupts the target, causing 90 Shadow damage over 15 sec.

spell:6390.name: Stoneclaw Totem
spell:6390.description: Summons a Stoneclaw Totem with 150 health at the feet of the caster for 15 sec that taunts creatures within 8 yards to attack it. Enemies attacking the Stoneclaw Totem have a 50% chance to be stunned for 3 sec. Stoneclaw totem also protects all your totems, causing them to absorb 58 damage.

spell:6546.name: Rend
spell:6546.description: Wounds the target causing them to bleed for 40 damage plus an additional 1528.571 (based on weapon damage) over 15 sec.
spell:6546.auraDescription: Bleeding for 8 plus a percentage of weapon damage every 3 seconds.

spell:6562.name: Heroic Presence
spell:6562.description: Increases chance to hit with all spells and attacks by 1% for you and all party members within 30 yards.

spell:6572.name: Revenge
spell:6572.description: Instantly counterattack an enemy for 161 to 183 damage. Revenge is only usable after the warrior blocks, dodges or parries an attack.

spell:6603.name: Auto Attack
spell:6603.description: Automatically attacks a target in melee with an equipped weapon until cancelled.

spell:6761.name: Eviscerate
spell:6761.description:
Finishing move that causes damage per combo point:
   1 point  : 31-53 damage
   2 points: 56-86 damage
   3 points: 81-119 damage
   4 points: 106-152 damage
   5 points: 131-185 damage

spell:6770.name: Sap
spell:6770.description: Incapacitates the target for up to 25 sec. Must be stealthed. Only works on Humanoids that are not in combat. Any damage caused will revive the target. Only 1 target may be sapped at a time.

spell:6795.name: Growl
spell:6795.description: Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.

spell:6808.name: Maul
spell:6808.description: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 27 and causes a high amount of threat. Effects which increase Bleed damage also increase Maul damage.

spell:6991.name: Feed Pet
spell:6991.description: Feed your pet the selected item. Feeding your pet increases happiness. Using food close to the pet's level will have a better result.

spell:7218.name: Weapon Counterweight
spell:7218.description: Attaches a counterweight to a two-handed sword, mace, axe or polearm increasing the wielder's haste rating by 20.

spell:7294.name: Retribution Aura
spell:7294.description: Causes 10 Holy damage to any enemy that strikes a party or raid member within 40 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.
spell:7294.auraDescription: Does 10 Holy damage to anyone who strikes you.

spell:7300.name: Frost Armor
